aliases: Applied Digital Ellendale AI data center
Applied Digital North Dakota AI campus
status_as_of_cutoff: Applied Digital's Ellendale HPC expansion is supported by official North Dakota inspection and utility/environmental records. The governor's 2025-03-19 release says the 380,000-square-foot HPC facility was under construction and expected to begin operations late that year, followed by two 900,000-square-foot expansions. A 2026-06-15 state notice concerns an air permit to construct the backup-power plant, and a 2026-06-11 MDU PSC filing concerns permanent service to an Applied Digital man camp. Trade reporting says a second building was complete on 2026-07-02. No complete building-by-building CO/energization/commissioning register was located.

actions.result_status: Trade reporting identifies September 2022 as the start of Polaris Forge 1 construction. No original permit or government groundbreaking record was located in the reviewed pass.
actions.access_caveat: Specialist trade report; date is not independently verified by a retrieved building record.
actions.evidence_note: Construction history explicitly labeled trade evidence.

actions.government_body: Office of the Governor of North Dakota
actions.result_status: Governor Armstrong and state/local officials inspected Applied Digital's Ellendale HPC expansion and related housing project, both described as under construction. The release describes a current 380,000-square-foot HPC facility and two planned 900,000-square-foot expansions.
actions.access_caveat: Inspection is not a CO, energization, commissioning, or live-service record.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Industrial Commission / Transmission Authority
actions.result_status: The state study lists Applied Digital Ellendale data-center scenarios at 100 MW (2025), 150 MW (2026), and 150 MW (2027), while also listing an in-service 180 MW blockchain facility. These are planning scenarios, not measured IT load or energization proof.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: 2025 Future-Proofing North Dakota's Electrical Capacity Study
actions.access_caveat: State study values use different phase/load definitions and are not a permit or utility service certificate.
actions.evidence_note: Official utility/planning context; phase values preserved without normalization.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Public Service Commission / Montana-Dakota Utilities
actions.result_status: MDU filed PU-26-173 seeking authority to provide permanent electric service to an Applied Digital man camp near Ellendale. The filing is service-process evidence, not proof of data-center energization.
actions.access_caveat: Application was pending; it concerns the man camp and does not establish the HPC buildings' delivered load.

actions.government_body: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality
actions.result_status: NDDEQ posted a notice of intent to issue an air-pollution-control Permit to Construct for Applied Digital Corporation's Ellendale backup-power generation plant.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: NDDEQ public notice ID 4034; permit number not exposed in search result
actions.access_caveat: Notice of intent is not the final permit, operation, energization, or commissioning record.

actions.result_status: Trade reporting says Applied Digital completed a second building at the North Dakota campus and that the campus capacity was contracted to CoreWeave. No CO or utility energization record was located.
actions.access_caveat: Specialist trade report; completion, contract, and live status are not upgraded without government closeout evidence.
